title: Meet M2 Lab: design the customer handoff
hooks: You sent the reminder. Can the customer actually tell what to do next?
Your AI map needs one person at the far right.
If the recipient cannot use the output, the automation has missed the job.
full_spoken_english: You sent the reminder. Can the customer actually tell what to do next? Imagine an appointment message with a date but no clear way to ask for a change. The sending task is done; the customer is stuck. M2 Lab looks at AI adoption from both sides of that handoff: the team doing the work and the person receiving it. Map the confirmed facts, the draft reminder, the customer's response, and the staff member who handles changes. AI could help prepare the wording. Your team still needs to agree what happens when someone replies with an unusual request. Read the message as the customer. Is the next step clear? Then read it as the staff member. Is the response actionable? At the end of your next process map, draw the person receiving the result. What do they need from it?
cta: At the end of your next process map, draw the person receiving the result. What do they need from it?

caption_plan: Editable sentence captions, maximum two short lines; keep proof labels clear. Captions paraphrase nothing that changes a fact. Final platform safe-zone check after edit.
